name: Ben & Jerry's Non-Dairy Chocolate Fudge Brownie
whyItWorks: Made with an oat milk base and soft, chewy Greyston Bakery fudge brownies. Completely dairy-free, nut-free, and seedless; the soft brownie chunks disintegrate easily without sharp edges.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat in modest 1/2 cup portions to keep rich cocoa oils easy to digest.
